clips.title: The story
paras: At Tor'kren Farm in northwestern Durotar, Misha Tor'kren waits anxiously for news of her son Kron. He has not returned from a hunting trip.

Tor'kren Farm struggles to raise pigs in Durotar's dry red dirt. The homestead lies southeast of Thunder Ridge, near the Southfury River. Feed and water are scarce, and the farm is isolated beneath nearby bluffs. Its yields are meager.

Kron went west several days ago to hunt crocolisks along the Southfury River. Misha Tor'kren warned him about the vicious predators, but he left in anger. Now she asks passing adventurers to search for him or bring back a sign of his fate. She fears the worst, but cannot begin mourning without knowing what happened.
